title: Saigon journalist's thanks to Eisenhower and goodbyes
summary: Jack relays a Saigon writer's message that sending the tour was the best thing sent, then the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview
